author: pritampalit
body:
This model files are regarding "TensorFlow-to-ONNX Migration of CMS DeepTau
Models for Efficient Inference in CMSSW and SONIC". 
Details can be found in this DP note : https://cmsfence.cern.ch/alcm/note/details/20647

- DeepTauId/*.onnx, BoostedDeepTauId/*.onnx: direct inference models for the TF->ONNX migration of CMSSW DeepTau implmentation (2017v2p6_e6 (v2.1), 2018v2p5 (v2.5), 2026v2p5 (phase 2), boosted RunIIv2p0 (boosted))
- DeepTauIdSONIC_ONNX/: Triton model repository serving the same DeepTau models via the ONNX backend. Kept as a separate top-level repository because the ONNX and TF configs declare the same model names, which Triton requires to be unique within one model repository.
- DeepTauIdSONIC/boostedDeepTau_RunIIv2p0/: TensorFlow graphdef + config newly added for boosted DeepTau, which was not present in the existing SONIC repository and is used in this study.

Existing .pb and .graphdef files are unchanged.
title: Add ONNX DeepTau models for CMSSW and SONIC and Tensorflow boosted DeepTau model for SONIC
